reviews.comment: Dr. Brunson is amazing! She is very respectful towards her students and does well at her craft. In her seminar class, it's very discussion-based, so be prepared to read and provide feedback! She loves her students who do so. She's very engaging with her lectures as well, building everyone's points into a common thought process. Highly Recommend!

Dr Brunson is great, and her class on Colonial Latin America was interesting. Her class is very discussion-heavy, but she asks thought-provoking questions, which make the discussions fun. Almost all her assignments are based on the readings, and they are not dense at all. Overall, her class is easy if you do all that's required.

Dr Brunson's seminar on Cuban history was intriguing and enjoyable. The way she structured her class was efficient, as we were able to read and learn about Cuban history while also building our writing skills for the final paper. She provides excellent feedback on assignments and will help you in any way she can.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Having taken Prof. Brunson twice, I can confidently say she's one of the best in the history department. Engaging class discussions, thought-provoking readings, and genuine care for students make her stand out. She's flexible, clear, and incredibly wise—learning from her is truly a gift!

I literally have no idea what the point of class time was. I did not learn anything and by halfway through the semester I stopped going. The class was not well organized and completely discussion based, but we were not given enough content to study to know what we were meant to discuss.
